_doc: One preset per reference reel. base = engine style; look = fonts/colours/sound/zoom defaults (plan.look overrides); plan = default plan keys; guide = what the plan should contain to match the reel. ref-* presets come from the 12-reel reference study (see REFERENCE_STUDY.md).

kilgore-list.ref: @itsmegkilgore DewrbKMRjlE — '15 ways Claude edits my reels'
kilgore-list.guide: Wide locked shot, almost no cuts. Stacked hook header (handwritten yellow line + white sans line + handwritten sub). One white UI card per list item above the head (app/list/notification/stat/photo), 1.5-3 s each. One word at a time, ~1 in 4 yellow serif accents. Selfie-style tight hook and CTA (start_tight, last shot tight). End card typed.

kilgore-story.guide: Curiosity header ('send this to a dreamer' + handwritten 'it's time to say it out loud' + 'just wait for the ending'). Emotional passages as handwritten white lines with the key phrase in yellow (story). A pip card ('me one month ago') when an old clip/photo is referenced. Very few cuts, gentle zooms, black typed end card.

kilgore-community.ref: @itsmegkilgore Dej25RgxvOD — 'half a million from one launch / build the room'
kilgore-community.guide: Big yellow serif numbers ($27,000), one-word captions with yellow serif accents, a comments scatter card whenever community/people/DMs are mentioned, a tilted reaction photo card top-left on surprising lines, stickers (🤯) on the emotional payoff, handwritten lines for the lesson at the end.

kilgore-skit.ref: @itsmegkilgore De15Uy2x_tU — 'I taught my laptop to do my laundry'
kilgore-skit.guide: Tight selfie hook, then cuts every 2-4 s alternating wide/tight, punch-in on every beat. Handwritten yellow instruction lines ('Then you're gonna need to add this connector.'). A chat card (iMessage bubble) for the punchline message. One word at a time. Short tight close ('Next, I'm gonna teach Claude to do the dishes').

kilgore-flip.ref: @itsmegkilgore DezH_DVRfIL — 'If you use AI you'll look generic... just kidding'
kilgore-flip.guide: Provocative tight hook line, then a hard flip ('Just kidding.') with a 😜 sticker and handwritten yellow 'Just kidding.'. Feature beats get white UI cards (brand kit = app/list cards with colour dots). Accent words like 'free' in yellow serif. Handwritten aside above the head ('wayyy more being given after launch ends!!'). Black typed end card.

gallo-promo.guide: Light lavender full-screen cards (dark:false) with clean product UI: steps/flow/browser/list cards, one key phrase per headline in a blue-purple-orange gradient (gradient_text). Host cut between cards; white bold captions. A refund/guarantee badge pill near the end.

edita-lawyer.ref: @edita.visuals DewlyZSNcme — 'when your home is paid off'
edita-lawyer.guide: Reference stack keyword blocks (lead 'You throw' / main 'A PARTY' / tail 'somebody') on every punchline; light-blue glass progress bar; dark check/cross pills with a click cursor; a 'Yes or No?' answer card; polaroid card with a red tag ('NOT CARRY'); emoji answer chips; a 'STRONGLY RECOMMEND' pill at the end. B-roll sparse.

edita-interview.guide: Lime serif italic keywords with a small light lead and tail ('I would say just' / 'go ahead' / 'build the product'). Archive/vintage B-roll (desaturated) on every reference to the past; retro window cards ('TACIT KNOWLEDGE NOT FOUND' warning dialog, media-player style); quote card for the key line. Calm camera.

edita-blueprint.guide: Showcase frame (raw clip beside the edit). Text-card interstitials with slow zoom: light card with blue list text (steps, dark:false) and a dark purple 'Blueprint' list card (Content / Distribution / Sales). Keyword blocks sparse, captions small.

edita-podcast.guide: Warm terracotta serif keywords. Rapid B-roll montage: one full-screen photo per list item (each herb/product ~1 s), split screens for 'the point is' lines, a quote card for 'the magic and the reality of ...'. Music swells slightly mid-reel.

reubx-bold.guide: Hooky talking head. Heavy white condensed keywords with black outline, one yellow highlight word per caption, dynamic transitions (whip, zoom-through, flash, glitch, light leak) at every section, impact shake on punchlines, B-roll every 6-8 s.

reubx-clean.guide: Calm expert explainer. White serif keywords, bold white captions with a yellow key word, zoom-through / blur / light-leak transitions only at section changes, no shake, slow push-ins, archive-look B-roll.

reubx-tutorial.guide: Screen recordings and walkthroughs: the recording is kept whole on a soft backdrop with a smart zoom that follows the cursor and typing, captions under the screen, lime key words, step cards between sections.

ref-kallaway.guide: Dark moody grade. Talking head <-> split screen (black diagram/UI top, speaker in a rounded card bottom) <-> full black diagram frames with white/red line art. One white bold word at a time, centred. Red label boxes as section titles. Hard cuts only. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-socialinfluence.guide: One locked bright shot, no cuts. Black-on-white box section headers ('1. TRANSFORMATION'), white typed example cards, bold white chest captions with soft shadow. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-adamkelada.guide: Screen recordings of the app on a dark stage with a warm gold glow, cursor highlight, outlined checklist of the 6 settings, small picture-card speaker. Captions white bold, key phrase in gold. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-wolf.guide: Wide locked podcast shot, slow push-ins. Two-line captions: small white lead + big yellow uppercase keyword. Yellow-outlined icon tiles above the head, a full-screen 3D chart break on black. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-tumi.guide: Warm backlit grade. Every beat is a stack: small white lead top-left, one huge metallic-gold word, small tail bottom-right. Light grey split cards on top with checklist rows popping in. Light paper word cards ('6 Months', 'Good News'). Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-millie.guide: One locked wide shot, no cuts. Captions mix bold sans with big handwritten script words. 'Mistake #3: low effort' style headers top, 'DO THIS instead', username keyword pill for the CTA. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-zach.guide: Split screen all the way: clean white canvas top half with product UI mock-ups (folders, toggles, lead lists, pricing cards) animating in, speaker bottom half. Small white captions on a dark pill at the seam. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-skytan.guide: One dark locked shot, no cuts. Glassy green HUD above the head: progress bar timeline, arc charts, phone cards with B-roll clips, face stickers. Big green title, regular-weight white captions. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-deshna.guide: Dark warm desk set, hard cuts between wide and tight. Captions stack bold sans with script italic words; the key phrase sits in a red box. White paper full-screen cards with small grey text. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-chloe.guide: Fastest pacing (a cut every 3 s). Small white captions above the head with yellow key words, '#1 Repetition' numbered headers, picture cards over the blurred speaker for every example, stickers, YouTube screenshot cards. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.

ref-cinematic.guide: Cinematic, very dark and desaturated with grain. Gold serif keywords, tilted glass list cards writing in, neon line chart, circle-masked face with bullet list, sparkles, map route and trophy as full-screen B-roll. Reference study (all 12 reels): hard cuts, layout changes carry the motion, 1-3 word captions, one emphasised word, muted grade, tight pacing.
